insight.title: Your Face Carries the Shape of Your Favorite Days
insight.subtitle: The lines we trace in the mirror are just the physical footprints of the moments we smiled.
insight.notificationHook: Your face is a map of your laughter

sections.text: Look closely at the quiet lines around a person’s eyes. These are not signs of wear, but the gentle paths carved by a lifetime of looking at the people and things they loved.
Our skin is incredibly patient, adapting to our habits. When we laugh, wonder, or squint at the morning sun, our body memorizes these shapes, gently keeping a physical record of our days.
Aging is not the fading of youth, but the gradual gathering of a life. Your face slowly becomes a visible story, showing the world exactly how deeply you have cared.
You are simply wearing the beautiful evidence of having been here.
